schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Boston Public Schools dates for 2026–27, including staggered opening dates, Winter Recess, February Recess, Spring Recess, early-release days, the senior last day, the scheduled last day of school, and translated calendar files.
heroSummary: Boston Public Schools uses staggered start dates for the 2026–27 school year. BPS lists September 2 and 3 as opening dates for UP Academy Dorchester. Students in grades 1–12 report on Tuesday, September 8, followed by pre-K and kindergarten students on Thursday, September 10. The scheduled last day of school is Tuesday, June 22, 2027, unless cancellations extend the school year.
calendarNotes: The 2026–27 BPS district calendar lists 180 school days and a separate 185th calendar day on June 29. Winter Recess runs December 24 through January 1, with teachers and paraprofessionals returning January 4 and students returning January 5. February Recess runs February 16–19, and Spring Recess runs April 20–23 after Patriots' Day.
verificationBadgeText: Last checked July 31, 2026. The official BPS PDF carries a review date of March 23, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Which BPS start date applies to my child?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the start date that matches your child's school and grade group. BPS lists September 2 and 3 as opening dates for UP Academy Dorchester, September 8 for students in grades 1–12, and September 10 for pre-K and kindergarten students.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded BPS calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import for calendar apps. If BPS revises the district calendar, download a new file and confirm changes on the official BPS calendar page.

calendarFaqs.q: What does the 185th calendar day mean?
calendarFaqs.a: BPS lists June 29 as the 185th calendar day. It is not the scheduled last day of school, but it may become relevant if cancellations extend the school year.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for schedule changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official BPS district calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation. School-specific events, bell schedules, transportation updates, testing dates, and program calendars may be published separately by individual schools.
Yes. BPS lists 2026–27 district calendar translations in Spanish, Arabic, Kabuverdianu, Chinese, French, Haitian Creole, Portuguese, Somali, and Vietnamese.

customSections.label: Recesses and Student Return Dates
customSections.content: The recess date ranges end before students return to class, so the return dates are listed separately below. After Winter Recess, staff return January 4 and students return January 5.

customSections.label: Important End-of-Year Notes
customSections.content: June 22 is both an early-release day and the scheduled last day of school, provided no days are lost to cancellations. BPS lists June 29 as the 185th calendar day, which may become relevant if cancellations extend the school year. Check BPS updates near the end of the year.
